_comment: The Codex half of switchboard's routing. Codex 0.151 takes the same hooks.json
shape as Claude Code, so this is hooks/hooks.json running the other way round.
It is not installed by default: ~/.codex/hooks.json is your file, and it may
already hold hooks of your own. `./install.sh --codex-hooks` merges this entry
into it (and `./install.sh --uninstall` takes it back out again).
${SWITCHBOARD_HOME} is substituted for the real checkout path on install;
Codex does not expand it, and a user-level hooks.json gets no plugin root.
Stop runs on-limit.mjs, which hands the conversation on when the turn ended in
